feature_contract.goal: Remove repeated full-span indexed-VB mask zero-fills on changed index-buffer generations without altering per-eye HUD and world referenced vertices, safety fallback, or cache identity.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: R30 indexed VB sparse-mask reset and deterministic gate only; excludes main-menu, HUD/F11/ESC, protected stereo/world/SkyGlow, DX11, DXVK, FFB.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Changed IB generation currently calls used.assign(vertexCount,0) over the entire minRaw..maxRaw span even when few VB indices were touched. The UP decoder already safely clears only prior touched indices. Avoid redundant O(full-span) resets on IB changes; no measured Quest3 frame timing available.
trace_stages: OutRun indexed VB draw supplies immutable shadow IB generation, signed base and physical vertex bounds.
R30 builds a producer-owned local index mask and touched list after generation cache miss, then reuses unchanged decoder output.
Both left and right XYZRHW transforms consume the identical mask and indexed DrawUP replay while original D3D9 remains conservative fallback.
subcomponents: Reset the previous touched bits before changing the VB mask span and keep partial decode failures recoverable.
Keep original 16/32-bit rebasing, bounds, cached-hit validation and both-eye mask consumption unchanged.
Extend exact-gate indexed VB regression with destructive reset mutations and multi-generation reference-mask parity.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: New IB revisions reconstruct identical touched masks and stereo source vertices with O(previous selected indices) clearing instead of O(full VB span).
Changed IB after failures or shrink/grow retains no stale membership, while unchanged IB cache and signed rebasing remain correct.
Indexed VB negative and positive tests plus exact SHA DX9Ex Active Win32 game/host/package, Domain Isolation and source impact gates pass.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R30TryXyzrhwIndexedPrimitiveVB uses vector::assign(vertexCount,0) on each IB cache miss, even when vertexCount is much greater than unique referenced indices.
diagnosis.root_cause: Full-span mask zero-fill is unconditional on changed IB ranges despite the already captured unique vbTouched list that identifies every previous set bit.
source_trace: Original DrawIndexedPrimitive binds the changing IB and VB shadow revisions.
R30 remaps raw indices to a local used mask, protects append-before-mark and calculates depth/world classification.
Left/right XYZRHW transformed vertex buffers and indexed fallback consume the same validated reference list.
alternatives_rejected: Simply skipping all mask clearing would leak stale per-eye world/HUD vertices.
Clearing previous references after resizing is invalid when the prior span was larger.
Caching unsafe decoded IB generations would risk invalid references after DISCARD or Release.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Clear vbTouched mask entries before resizing and retain unchanged cache signatures, fail-closed recovery, index rebasing and both-eye transforms.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: 5 source destructive mutations and 2200 randomized changed-generation/shrink/grow/partial-decode parity cases in CI-integrated index rebase verifier.

performance_evidence: Source-level reduction only; HMD FPS not measured.
